title: Planning Over Rough Ground: Paying for Sand and Slope in Energy, Paying for Risk, and When the Shortest Way Is Not the Cheapest

artifact.note: planning over rough ground: a terrain grid of surface and slope per cell, the energy of a metre from rolling resistance and the slope along the heading, a step cost that adds weighted energy and weighted risk (from a cost layer) to the distance, blocked cells never crossed, and an A* search over eight neighbours that finds the cheapest path, not the shortest
